info.title: Pappaliiga Stats API
info.description: REST API for CS2 tournament statistics

get.description:
Get aggregate statistics across all seasons.

Returns total counts of divisions, teams, players, matches, maps, rounds, kills, and deaths.
Excludes banned/quit teams based on division_overrides.json per championship.

Returns:
    dict: Aggregate statistics wrapped in "all_seasons" key

Get metadata for all seasons with aggregate statistics.

Returns list of seasons with division counts, team/player counts (excluding banned/quit),
match progress, and stats for maps/rounds/kills/deaths.

Returns:
    list[dict]: List of season objects sorted by season number descending

Get division cards for a specific season.

Args:
    season: Season number

Returns:
    list[dict]: List of division objects with slug, tier, counts, and progress
